title: JudgePanel: A Compact Judge with Panel Deliberation via Adaptive Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.29168v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm has emerged as a scalable alternative to human evaluation. However, single-model judges are limited by their inherent model biases, while multi-agent evaluation protocols that mitigate this through diverse deliberation are prohibitively expensive at inference time. To this end, we propose \textbf{\modelname}, which equips a compact \underline{Judge} model with multi-agent \underline{Panel} deliberation capability. Specifically, we first train on panel deliberation traces from an ensemble of strong evaluators, capturing structured patterns of discussion, disagreement, and resolution. To further improve judgment quality beyond SFT, we introduce \textit{AdaReward}, an adaptive multi-reward RL algorithm that dynamically rebalances reward component weights as different objectives saturate at different rates during RL training. translated_title: JudgePanel：通过自适应多奖励强化学习实现具备评审团商议能力的紧凑型评判模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.29168v1 公告类型：新 摘要：LLM-as-a-Judge（大语言模型作为评判者）范式已成为人类评估的一种可扩展替代方案。然而，单模型评判者受限于其固有的模型偏见，而通过多样化商议来缓解这一问题的多智能体评估协议在推理时成本高昂得令人望而却步。为此，我们提出了JudgePanel，它为紧凑型评判模型配备了多智能体评审团商议能力。具体而言，我们首先在一组强大评估器集合所产生的评审团商议轨迹上进行训练，从而捕捉讨论、分歧与解决的结构化模式。为了在监督微调（SFT）的基础上进一步提升评判质量，我们引入了AdaReward，这是一种自适应多奖励强化学习算法，能够在强化学习训练过程中，随着不同目标以不同速率趋于饱和而动态重新平衡各奖励组件的权重。为了便于实际部署，我们进一步设计了一个轻量级的领域专业化模块……
tldr: 该论文提出JudgePanel，通过在强评估器商议轨迹上训练并采用自适应多奖励强化学习算法AdaReward动态平衡训练目标，使紧凑型评判模型具备多智能体评审团商议能力，以低推理成本实现高质量的LLM自动评估。
en_tdlr: JudgePanel equips a compact LLM judge with multi-agent panel deliberation capability through training on deliberation traces and an adaptive multi-reward RL algorithm (AdaReward), achieving high-quality LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation at low inference cost.
